title: Judge verdicts: JUDGE stage output, WRITE stage input
description: The contract between the judging model and the renderer. Validating here keeps the report and CSV exports pure formatting: drift in the model's output fails as a schema error instead of producing a broken export.

none_reason.description: Why fewer accounts were kept than the target, or none at all. Expected whenever the result falls short.

accounts.description: Accounts the judge would contact, best first.

rejected.description: Accounts the judge read and would not contact, each with a reason. For a market map these are removed from the export as false positives.

fit.description: strong: matches the ideal customer file on every point that can be checked. possible: matches, with open questions named in risks.

what_they_do.description: One or two sentences from the company's own site or listing. Says 'unverified' when there was no site to read.

why_fit.description: Each point cites the context record behind it (an ideal_customer section or a proof id), which keeps the model from inventing reasons or results.

contact_role.description: The role to reach, never a named person.

draft.description: A first draft for a person to edit. Never sent by the pipeline.
